## Abstract

Five sentences: what was done, with what, what was found (with the decisive
numbers), what is recommended.

## I. Objective

Numbered, falsifiable.

## II. Materials

| Item | Detail (model, version, commit, retrieval date) |
| --- | --- |

## III. Method

What was read, run, or measured, in the order it happened, so that a second
reader can repeat it.

## IV. Results

Tagged statements. Tables for numbers. Cite `analysis/` tables for every
derived figure.

## V. Discussion

Interpretation, limits of the method, what would refute the conclusions.
Opinions are labelled.

## VI. Recommendations and best practice

Numbered. Each names the backlog entry, spec statement, or process rule it
becomes.

## VII. References

Files in this repository, then `resources/` items by manifest row, then URLs.
